verifications.claim: As of early April 2026, Elon Musk is the world's wealthiest person.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Musk has been the wealthiest person in the world since 2025; as of April 2026, Forbes estimates his net worth to be US$809 billion.' R7: Rank 1 Elon Musk $831.5B.
verifications.reasoning: Directly supported by R2 specifying April 2026 and R7 real-time list showing Musk #1.

verifications.claim: As of early April 2026, Elon Musk's net worth is estimated around $823 billion to $852 billion.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R2: 'as of April 2026, Forbes estimates his net worth to be US$809 billion.' R6: '$839 billion' (March 2026). R7: '$831.5B'.
verifications.reasoning: Figures around $809B-$839B in early 2026 match the range broadly, but not precisely $823-852B; approximate support.
